In general, too empty and not enough objects to complement the beds. instead of having two walls lined with beds, try one wall of beds and one wall of weapon and armor racks. Transform the barracks from a giant room with beds to a place where warriors sleep and keep their combat gear. 

Ogre barracks are completely different than regular barracks. These ones in general look pretty good because they're more minimal, as would be expected of ogres. The expectations for ogre barracks are different than for human barracks. Separate these two categories out.
